Tourist flow is roughly high in January—March, gradually declines in April—June, rises again in July, slightly decreases in August, and is relatively low in September; from September to October the curve rises obviously, and afterward it continues to rise in November and December. Then reason: The stem asks "in the reason analysis judged to be wrong, in which month did the increase in tourists occur." According to the original analysis statement, the item judged to be wrong is attributing the increase in tourists to the "Golden Week" effect, and that statement points to the increase in tourists in October. Therefore, the increase in tourists occurred in October.

In the reason analysis judged to be wrong, in which month did the increase in tourists occur?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中各月游客流量的走势，确认10月相对9月有上升。再读取题干中“被判定为错误的原因分析”所对应的原分析表述，即把游客增多归因于“黄金周”效应的那一项；该表述本身指向“10月份游客增多”。据此回答发生游客增多的月份为10月份。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴为1—12月，纵轴为游客流量。游客流量大致在1—3月较高，4—6月逐步下降，7月回升，8月略降，9月较低；从9月到10月曲线明显上升，之后11月、12月继续升高。再推理：题干问“在被判定为错误的原因分析中，游客增多发生在哪个月份”。按照原分析表述，被判定为错误的那项是把游客增多归因于“黄金周”效应，而该表述指向的是10月份游客增多。因此，游客增多发生在10月份。
